COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
C482 No. 1530 of 2023
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Jitendra Chaudhary, Advocate, for the
applicant.
The present applicant is the wife of
respondent No.1, who is admittedly, residing in
Canada. Due to aforesaid contingency, he could
not be served with the notices.
The C-482 Application has been filed by the
applicant seeking an expeditious disposal of
Domestic Violence Case No. 317 of 2022, Mrs.
Arzoo Batta Vs. Mr. Amit Rekhi and others, being
the proceedings under Sections 18, 19, 20 and 22 of
the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence
Act, which is pending consideration before the
Court of 3rd Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Dehradun.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits,
that the impediment in proceeding with the case is
because of the fact, that the husband/ respondent
No.1, has not been served with the notices and
rather he argues that he is avoiding service of notice
and taking advantage of the fact because he is
residing in Canada, he cannot be effectively served
with the notices by the present applicant.
In order to carve out an exception, the Court
of 3rd Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun, is

directed to permit the applicant to serve respondent
No.1 through the mail address, as it has been given
in the cause tile of the proceedings of the Domestic
Violence Act, and apart from it, he will also permit
the applicant to serve the respondent No.1 through
the Embassy of Canada.
As soon as the aforesaid steps are taken, the
Court of 3rd Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Dehradun, would ensure to decide the proceedings
of Domestic Violence Case No. 317 of 2022, Mrs.
Arzoo Batta Vs. Mr. Amit Rekhi and others, as
expeditiously as possible, but not later than six
months from the date of service of notice on
respondent No.1.
Subject to the above, the C-482 Application
stands disposed of.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 01.08.2023
Shiv
